description: Australian Infrastructure and Transport Statistics Yearbooks (2007 to current) is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by Actuaries Institute; publisher not stated. Members: Australian Infrastructure and Transport Statistics Yearbook - 2021 to current; Australian Infrastructure Statistics Yearbooks 2007 - 2020. Example entry: The aim of the Australian Infrastructure and Transport Statistics Yearbook is to provide a single annual source of infrastructure statistics for use by policymakers, industry leaders, transport analysts and the wider Australian community. The publication is primarily a source of long-term, aggregate time series infrastructure statistics. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current and non-current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-12-15. Files and pages listed: PDF, XLSX, ZIP (22 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
